tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// tshe dpag lha dgu'i dkyil chog smin dbang rab gsal snang ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na nā tha ye/ 'dir bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pas/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa rang gis bsgrub cing de'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzhung ji lta bar gzhan la bskur zhing 'chi ba bslu bar 'dod pas/ thog mar stegs kyi khar maṇ+ḍal dgu tshom mam/ ras bris dkyil 'khor steng du/ gtso bum dung chos rdo rje dang bcas shar sgo'i g.yas/ las bum g.yon du bzhag la/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ nub ngos su mchod gtor dgu tshom/ sgo bzhir dkar gtor bzhi dang*/ cha gsum gtor ma bshams/ khrus byas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ oṃ ha ya gṝ wa hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che yi snod// yangs shing rgya che'i nang du ni// khaṃ las lha rdzas las grub pa'i// gtor ma 'dod yon phun tshogs gyur// a kā ro sogs brjod/ ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/ sogs/ hūm̐/ sa la rgyu ba'i lha kun dang*// gang yang sa steng gnas pa rnams// sems can kun la dge don du// byams pa'i sems kyis gnas par mdzod// ces phul/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ yig las// rin chen snod kyi nang du 3ni// oṃ las byung ba'i mchod yon dang*// zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos sogs// mchod rdzas bsam mi khyab par gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sā hā/ sogs kyis byin brlabs/ de nas skyabs 'gro ni/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pa'i// brtson pa'i sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya//

sogs kyis sems bskyed bya/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid skad cig tshe dpag med// thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas// bla ma bcom ldan tshe dpag med// dkyil 'khor mdun du spyan drangs gyur// thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ra we sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra pā da ban+da naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes phyag bya/ thugs ka'i sa bon las spros pa'i// lha mo mchod rdzas 'dzin pas mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na sa pa ri wā ra bh+ya badz+ra ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal mūḥ tshogs zhing gshegs/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dngos gzhi ni/ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong nyid ye shes rdo rje las// baṃ dang raṃ las pad nyi'i steng*// hūm̐ las rdo rje'i srung 'khor nang*// sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du ni// bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi// sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi la sogs// mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'i// dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar// 'dab ma brgyad pa'i snying po dang*// 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i steng*// rang sems la dmigs nas/ byu ru'i mdog can hrīḥyig las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod sems can gyi// sgrib sbyang tshur 'dus yongs gyur las// dbus su rnam snang tshe dpag med// shar lho nub byang rim pa bzhin// rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang*// phrin las bya grub tshe dpag med// byang shar la sogs g.yas bskor du// kun gzigs yon tan ye shes dang*// mi g.yo tshe dpag med mgon rnams// sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'phro// zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gis// rin po che'i bum pa ni// tshe dang ye shes bdud rtsi yis// gang ba bsnams shing zhi nyams can// dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras// rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i// kun gyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po// mgrin par āḥdamar thugs ka yi// cha smad hūm̐ sngon gyis mtshan pa// gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dbus// hrīḥyig dmar po'i 'od zer gyis// bsgom pa lta bu'i ye shes pa// 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs gyur// badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ

bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// sogs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho gnyis med gyur// slar yang hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas// dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs te// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ gsol btab de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ gsung zhing ye shes bdud rtsi'i chus// dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag spyi bor 'khyil pa las// 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan gyur// ces lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la mnyam par bzhag /de la skyo na bzlas pa bya ste/ thugs kar gnas pa'i hrīḥyig mthar// sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las// 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi// sdig pa sgrib pa thams cad dang*// tshe dang dbang thang rgud pa bsal// sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dang*// lha dang mi yi rig 'dzin sogs// 'jig rten gsum gyi brtan g.yo'i bcud// bsdus nas rang gi lus la zhugs// thugs ka'i yig 'bru la thim pas// 'chi med tshe yi dpal 'byor dang*// ye shes dngos grub thob par gyur// oṃ na mo bh+rūm̐ ā yur+dz+nyā na hrīḥ.a ro li ka hūm̐ hrīḥ snying po'o// tad+ya thā a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na hrīḥhūm̐ bh+rūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags so// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te a pa ri mi ta sogs tshe gzungs brjod/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sha ba le/ a ba le/ sa ma dza le/ nir de she/ nir dzā te/ ni ruk+te/ nir mu khe/ dz+wa la pa ri ts+tsha da ne/ su kha wa tī nir de she/ a mṛ te/ ā yurgar+bha nir hā nir/ a mṛ ti ā yuḥpra sā dha ni/ nir bud+dhi/ ā kā sha nir de she/ ā kā sha ni de she/ ā kā sha nir dza te/ ā kā sha nir ku sha le/ ā kā nir dar+sha ne/ ā kā sha a dhiṣ+ṭhā ni/ su kha wa tī a dhiṣ+ṭha na/

rū pa ner de she/ tsa twā ri dharma pra sā dha ne/ tsa dwā ri ār+ya sat+ya pra sā dha ni/ tsa twā re marga bha wa na pra sā dha ne/ ba la bīr+ya pra sā dha ne/ dhar+m+ma ts+tshe da ne/ ku sha le/ ku sha la nir de she/ ku sha la pra tiṣ+ṭhā ni/ bud+dha ku sha le/ bi shud+dha pra bhā sa dharma ki ra ṇa/ nir dzā te/ nir budhe/ bi ma le/ be ra dze/ rā dza sa/ ra sā gre/ ra sā gra ba le/ ra sā gra a dhiṣ+ṭha te/ ku la/ pra ti ku le/ bi ku le/ dan+te/ su dān+ta tsit+te/ su pra shan+ta tsit+te/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhi te/ su le su mu khe/ dha me tsa dha me/ ba le ba tsa ba le/ a nu sha a wa le/ bud+dha ā kā sha gu ṇe/ budha ā kā sha nir gu ṇe/ a mṛ ta dun+du bhiḥswa re swā hā/ des 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs rnams bzla bya'i sngags te sngags de rnams gang la mos pa mi skyo'i bar du bzla/ thun 'jog na/ brtan par byed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dmar// 'dab bzhi zla ba'i gdan bcas steng*// rigs lnga tshe dpag med mgon dang*// spyi bo'i nam mkhar pad zla'i steng*// ye shes tshe dpag med mgon rnams// rgyan dang cha lugs yongs rdzogs pa// ye shes tshe dpag med pa yi// thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pa// 'phags pa rnams kyis byin rlabs dang*// brtan g.yo'i bcud dang nus pa bsdus// ye shes tshe dpag med la thim// de nyid bdud rtsir rab zhu ba// tshangs bug nas zhugs rigs lngar thim// de rnams zhu ba'i bdud rtsi yis*// lus kun khyab cing gang ba las// lus zungs sems kyi rten du gyur// mgon po tshe dpag med pa dang*// rang gi sgo gsum dbyer med pa'o// zhes snying po lan gsum bzla/ de nas bum pa'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ de'ang gtso bum la/ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong nyid ye shes rdo rje las// rnam rgyal bum pa'i go sa ru// sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma la// sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du ni// bh+rūm̐ las zhes pa nas/

'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan gyur// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ las bum la/ las kyi bum pa'i go sa ru// sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i steng*// hūm̐ las khro bo rta mgrin ni// dmar zhing nyi ma ltar 'bar ba// spyan gsum mche gtsigs hūm̐ sgra sgrogs// spyi bor rta mgo ljang gus mtshan// phyag bzhi pad dbyug rdo rje dang*// sdigs mdzub pad+ma'i sdong po 'dzin// g.yon brkyangs khro bo'i chas kyis brgyan// me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus bzhugs pa'i// gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs stod hrīḥ /'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho gnyis med gyur// slar yang dbang lhas dbang bskur te// snang ba mtha' yas dbu brgyan gyur// mchod bstod kyi rim pa ni sngar ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na sa pa ri wā ra bh+ya badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ 'don pa spos la mchod/ gzhan yang mchod pa rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor// sems can sdug bsngal ma lus pa// skad cig nyid la zhi mdzad pa// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal// rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba'i// nyes pa'i dri ma kun 'joms pa// rdo rje'i lus can rdo rje can// rdo rje tshe dpag med= /bsam pa'i don kun skad cig gis// rang 'dod ji bzhin tshim mdzad dpal// mchog gi bdag nyid chen po ste// rin chen tshe dpag med= /ji ltar nyon mongs dri ma yis// kun nas gos par mi 'byung zhing*// thugs rjes chags pa'i tshul ston pa// pad+ma tshe dpag med= /'dod pa'i don rnams ma lus pa// skad cig gis ni rdzogs pa'i dpal// bsam kun 'phel mdzad dpag bsam shing*// las kyi tshe dpag=

/nyes pa kun las rnam grol zhing*// sna tshogs yon tan kun gyis brgyan// 'khor ba'i skyabs mdzad dpa' bo ste// kun gzigs tshe dpag med= /stobs chen rnams kyis rab brgyan te// ma lus mi mthun phyogs bcom pa// ston pa sred med bu yi mthu// yon tan tshe dpag med= /me long mnyam nyid la sogs pa// ye shes mang po'i mdzod 'dzin cing*// rtog pa ma lus khyod kyis spangs// ye shes tshe dpag med= /rnam rtog rlung gis khyod mi g.yo// mtha' bral ting 'dzin zhi ba ste// bdud dang mu stegs 'joms mdzad pa// mi g.yo tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod/ bum bskyed kyi tshe/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rta mgrin rgyal// drag po'i rta skad sgrog pa yis// gdug pa can rnams 'joms par mdzad// khro bo'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal// bum pa'i steng gi dung gi chu la/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun bzlas/ de'i steng du gzungs thag rdo rje bzhag ba'i sne bzung la/ bdag bskyed zhal nas sngags bzlas pas// bum lha'i thugs brgyud bskul bar bsam// gtso bo la/ oṃ bai ro tsa na ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ badz+ra= pad+ma= rat+na= karma= zhes rigs bzhi dang*/ mtshams su/ oṃ sarba a wa lo ki te ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ gu ṇa= dz+nyā na= a tsa la/ sogs bzla/ las bum la gzungs thag spos nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bzla/ mthar dung gi chu mchod yon gyi tshul du 'bul/ gzhal yas khang dang lha tshogs rnams// 'od zhu bum pa'i bdud rtsir gyur// de nas mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ stong nyid ye shes rdo rje las// mdun gyi nam mkhar pad nyi dang*// sna tshogs rdo rje'i zhes pa nas/ dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad pa'i snying po dang*// 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i steng*// bye ru'i mdog can hrīḥyig las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod sems can gyi// sgrib sbyangs tshur 'dus yongs gyur las// dbus su rnam snang tshe dpag med// shar lho nub byang rim pa bzhin// rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang*// phrin las bya grub tshe dpag med// byang shar la sogs g.yas bskor du// kun gzigs yon tan ye shes dang*// mi g.yo tshe dpag med mgon rnams//

zhes dang*/ sku mdog dmar po sogs kyi skabs ltar las/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan gyur/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ bdag mdun lha tshogs thams cad kyis// mgrin gcig bzlas pa byed par 'gyur// zhes pa'i rjes su gtso 'khor gyi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la mchod pa dang bstod pa sngar ltar bya/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs sogs sngon gtor bzhin gyi/ a kā ro sogs/ tshe dpag med pa lha dgu yi// dkyil 'khor mdun du gsal bar gyur// bar mos nas mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ na maḥsarba thā ga te bh+yo sogs btags pa gsum gyis phul/ bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ gzhan gyi 'chi bslu byed par 'dod na/ dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhir rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma/ shar du 'o ma dang 'bras chan/ lhor nya sha dang btsos pa'i bye brag /nub tu sha rjen dang khrag sna/ byang du chang dang shing tog sna tshogs bkod nas/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs sngon 'gro ltar bya/ oṃ dri dha raṣ+ṭa ya na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs gsum gyis phul/ oṃ dri dha raṣ+ṭa ya sa pa ri wā re bh+yeḥ.ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs kyis mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa// dung gi mdog can pi waṃ 'dzin// dri za'i tshogs la dbang sgyur ba// yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyi rjes su/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa shar phyogs dri za'i gdon las gyur ba'i nad gdon nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin du/ bi ru ḍha ka ya na maḥ sogs kyis gtor mchod phul/ dpa' bo chen po stobs po che// kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin// grul bum tshogs la dbang sgyur ba// 'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod sbyin= sogs brjod/ bi ru pāk+ṣa ya na maḥ mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che// kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin// klu yi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba// mig mi bzang la=

/mchod sbyin= sogs dang*/ klu'i gdon las= sogs/ bai shra ba ṇa ya/ sogs/ sde dpon chen po gser mdog can// be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin// gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang sgyur ba// rnam thos sras la= mchod sbyin sogs/ de nas cha gsum gtor ma sngon 'gro bzhin byin brlabs nas btang la/ nang du phyin nas bdag 'jug len pa ni/ slob ma dbang bskur ba dang mtshungs shing khyad par cung zad la/

ji ltar bltams pa= sogs khrus nas lha ngo bstan pa'i bar dang*/ de nas maṇ+ḍal dang dbang gi dngos gzhi dkyus ltar bya'o// slob ma 'jug pa ni/ gos gsar pa bgos te mdun du 'tshogs/ chos bshad ci rigs dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas khyed rnams thog mar dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// dga' chen khyod bdag sogs/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ las bum gyi chus slob ma bsangs la sngags brjod/ sngon chad dkyil 'khor 'dir ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang gsang sgrog gi nyes pa spangs pa'i phyir gdong g.yogs 'ching bar mdzod/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha/ sogs/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag rten du yang zhing ma nyams pa'i me tog gi phreng ba zhig gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ a khaṃ bī rā hūm̐/ de nas khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad du gnas par mos la/ rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig mtha' dag rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig rnams su 'dus pa yin pas de dag rnams 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mgon po sangs rgyas sogs sdom bzung bya/ khyod rang gi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa zhig bsgom la thams cad rdo rje'i rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa'i nges pa dang ldan pas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da ya mi/ sems bskyed pa 'di nyid brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ snying khar rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa bzhag ste/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyi/ khyod kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing ma dad par yang mi bya'o//

zhes gsang bar gdams/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ de nas khyed rnams dkyil 'khor shar sgo'i mdun du khrid par mos shig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes shar sgo nas zhugs/ lha rnams gnas par mos te/ thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na ma ste hūm̐/ na ma mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod bcug la/ rdo rje tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka nas/ gnyis pa zhig thon pa khyed rang gi snying gar thim par mos mdzod/ de bzhin/ rin chen tshe dpag med sogs brjod/ zhes nub sgo sogs dang sngags bcas/ pad+ma tshe dpag med sogs bzhin/ zhes byang sgo sogs dang sngags bcas/ karma tshe dpag sogs brjod/ slar yang shar gyi lha snam du 'khod par mos shig / slob dpon gyis rdo rje gdengs bzhin pas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ des na ngas khyed la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub rnams kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis kyang dkyil 'khor 'di ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig yin gyi gal te 'ga' zhig la smras na klad pa 'gas par 'gyur ro// rdo rje snying khar bzhag la/ oṃ/ tshe dpag med mgon deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag bzhugs par mdzad// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam tshig gi chu sbyin pa ni/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ster// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥ bka' bsgo ba ni/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi tshe dpag tu med pa nga yin gyi ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/

khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par shi ba'i dus byas na dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ ye shes pa dbab pa'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /bdag la 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ da ye shes lha'i byin 'bebs pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs kyis slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mgon po tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas 'chi med tshe yi bum pa bsnams pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar hrīḥdamar po 'od 'bar ba/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang lha dang drang srong dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang grub pa thob pa dang*/ nor bu dang sman dang rtsi dang bcud la sogs pa la tshe bsring ba'i nus pa ji snyed yod pa thams cad hrīḥyig dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs lus thams cad hrīḥdamar pos gang bas 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang rdo rje lta bu'i srog thob par sgoms/ sngags thung gnyis dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes bdug pa rol mo dang bcas pas ye shes dbab/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ ye shes pa de nyid brtan par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ snang ba brtags pa ni/ de nas sngon tshe gang la sbyangs pa'i rigs kyi lha skal brtag pa'i don du/ pra tits+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod bzhin pas dkyil 'khor du me tog dor cig / slob mas sngags brjod bzhin pas me tog dor la/ slar me tog spyi bor bkod/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha de nyid kyis byin gyis brlab cing rjes su bzung bar mos shig

/pra ti gṛ h+ṇa swa i maṃ/ satwa ma hā ba la/ ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang lhan cig mig ras bsal pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mig dar bsal/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra a ba ha ra pa ṭa lam hrīḥswā hā/ lha ngo bstan pa ni/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum mthong bar mos shig / spro na/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid yon tan dpag tu med pa bde ba can gyi zhing khams kyi dbus su thar pa chen po'i pho brang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'brur zla ba'i gdan la chos dbyings ye shes gyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po/ shar dang shar lho'i 'dab mar me long ye shes kyi ngo bo rdo rje tshe dpag med dang*/ kun gzigs tshe dpag med/ lho dang lho nub kyi 'dab mar mnyam nyid ye shes kyi ngo bo rin chen tshe dpag med dang*/ yon tan tshe dpag med/ nub dang nub byang gi 'dab mar sor rtog ye shes kyi ngo bo pad+ma tshe dpag med dang ye shes tshe dpag med/ byang dang byang shar gyi 'dab mar bya grub ye shes kyi ngo bo karma tshe dpag med dang mi g.yo tshe dpag med rnams mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa gyis/ dbang gi dngos gzhi las/ thog mar bkru bya ba bsrung ba'i las bya ba ste/ bum pa lha grangs yod tshe mtshams bum bzhi dang*/ las bum gyis 'khrud pa yin kyang*/ bum pa gnyis las med na rnam rgyal nas las bum du cung zad blugs pas khrus bya ba ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams bzhi na bzhugs pa'i kun gzigs tshe dpag med dang*/ yon tan tshe dpag med dang*/ ye shes tshe dpag med dang*/ mi g.yo tshe dpag med rnams kyi phyag gi bum pa las babs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs lus kyi nang gang nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bkrus te 'og sgo dang*/

sen khrag nas dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam par thon pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// zhes sogs tshigs bcad kyi mthar/ snying po rta mgrin gyi sngags kyi rjes su che ge mo'i/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du/ nad thams cad= gdon thams cad= rims thams cad= yams thams cad= nye bar 'tshe ba= 'khon= grib= byad= byur= skal ba ngan pa= ltas ngan pa= rmi lam= bkra mi shis pa thams cad= dus ma yin 'chi ba= mtshan mo nag mo'i gdon= dus kyi zhags pa= gshin rje'i pho nya= bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bkru bas nad gdon dag par bsams te/ khrus byas pa'i mjug tu chu cung zad kha ru bzung du bcug /rma bya'i sgros byab pa'i tshe nad la sogs pa blangs te chur dor bar dmigs la/ da byab pas bsal ba ni/ rma bya'i sgro mdongs ku sha'i chun po dang bcas pa 'dis khyed rnams kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad rdo khab len gyi lcags phye blangs pa ltar 'ub kyis bsdus te khrus chur byabs nas bsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags gnyis kyi rjes su/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa na ya swā hā/ sogs gong bzhin brjod la byab par bya'o// khar gnas pa'i chu khrus chu'i nang du dor bcug /rgya gzhung las/ de nas chu de ma bo bar// chu bo che dang ldeng ka mtsho// chu chen rnams la dor gyur na// nges par 'chi las bzlog pa yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar chu la dor cig / ces chu de gdon bgegs rnams bskrad pa'i dmigs pa dang thun gyis brab/ bdug pa rol mo bya ba dang lhan cig dor bar bya'o// slob ma'i spyi bo/ mdun rgyab gnyis/ dpung pa gnyis/ pus mo gnyis la rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ da khyed rang rnams kyi gnas bdun du rdo rjes reg pas rdo rje de 'dra ba grangs med 'phros nas lus la rdo rje'i go khrab dang ldan pas nad gdon bar chad thams cad las phyin chad bsrung ba'i mos pa mdzod/

sngags gnyis brjod/ sdig pa sgrib pa thams cad las rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ sogs gong bzhin brjod do// 'chi bslu dang 'brel na/ dkyil 'khor du bzhag pa'i dar dmar la gzungs bris pa bsrung ba'i don du gdab bo// de nas bden pa'i tshig brjod de/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal// chos ni chos ma yin pa las// dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal// dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal// lha min zla ba rnams las rgyal// nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las// me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal// chu yang me las rgyal bar gyur// rlung gis sprin ni rnam par gtor// rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas// sa yang bden par gnas pa lags// sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden// de bzhin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bden// bden pa rgyal gyur rdzun ma lags// bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig 'di dag gis/ che ge mo zhes bya/ bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig dza ya dza ya/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas sngar gyi stan las bslangs te stan gsar pa zhig gi steng du bzhag la/ de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal/ zhes maṇ+ḍal phul la/ de nas khyed rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun bskyed dang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rigs sngags 'di la dgongs pa gcig pa dang dbyangs gcig pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ shar phyogs nas sangs rgyas bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu/ shar lho nas sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ lho phyogs nas sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bzhi bcu rtsa bdun/ lho nub nas sangs rgyas bye ba phrag drug cu rtsa lnga/ nub phyogs nas sangs rgyas bye ba phrag lnga bcu rtsa lnga/ nub byang nas sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bzhi bcu rtsa lnga/ byang phyogs nas sangs rgyas bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug /byang shar nas sangs rgyas bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga/

dbus phyogs nas sangs rgyas bye ba phrag gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs dang bcas pa rnams spyan drangs dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rnam snang tshe dpag tu med pas rin po che'i bum pa tshe dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams te spyi bor dbang bskur bas tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rkang mthil yan gyi lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ lus la rnam snang tshe dbang bskur// bu khyod 'chi bdag las grol te// bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel nas// srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /oṃ bai ro tsa na ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes cung zad 'thung du gzhug / sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// mi yi seṅge sbyin pa'i stobs rtogs te// snying rje can gyi grong khyer 'jug pa na// sbyin pa'i stobs kyi sgra ni grags par 'gyur// sbyin pa mthar phyin tshe ni 'phel bar shog / phar phyin gzhan la'ang sbyar bas bden stobs brjod/ de ltar dbang bskur bas 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang*/ khyad par du'ang gti mug gi sgo nas gzhan gyi srog bcad pas tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag /rnam snang tshe dpag med kyi ngo bor gyur/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor gnas pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje tshe dpag tu med pas rin po che'i bum pa tshe dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams te spyi bor dbang bskur bas tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rkang mthil yan gyi lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ bum pa dpral bar bzhag la/ lus la rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskur// bu khyod 'chi bdag las grol te// bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel nas// srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ā yudz+nyā na sid+dhi sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ tshul khrims stobs kyis sangs rgyas=

/ sogs dang*/ de ltar dbang bskur bas 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang*/ khyad par du'ang zhe sdang gi sgo nas gzhan gyi srog bcad pas tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag /rdo rje tshe dpag med pa'i ngo bor gyur/ chu'i lhag ma dpral ba'i steng du gnas pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshe dpag tu med pas rin po che'i bum pa tshe dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams te spyi bor dbang bskur bas tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rkang mthil yan gyi lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ bum pa ltag par bzhag la/ lus la pad+ma'i tshe dbang bskur// bu khyod 'chi bdag las grol te// bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel nas// srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /oṃ pad+ma ā yudz+nyā na sid+dhi sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ bzod pa'i stobs kyis/ sogs/ de ltar dbang bskur bas 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang*/ khyad par du'ang 'dod chags kyi sgo nas gzhan gyi srog bcad pas tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag /pad+ma tshe dpag med pa'i ngo bor gyur/ chu'i lhag ma ltag pa'i steng du gnas pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi rin chen tshe dpag tu med pas rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams te spyi bor dbang bskur bas tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rkang mthil yan gyi lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/

bum pa rna ltag g.yas su bzhag la/ lus la rin chen tshe dbang bskur// bu khyod 'chi bdag las grol te// bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel nas// srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /oṃ rat+na ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ brtson 'grus stobs= / sogs/ de ltar dbang bskur bas 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang/ khyad par du'ang ser sna dang nga rgyal gyi sgo nas gzhan gyi srog bcad pas tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag /rin chen tshe dpag med pa'i ngo bor gyur/ chu'i lhag ma rna ltag g.yas su gnas pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi las kyi tshe dpag tu med pas rin po che'i bum pa tshe dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams te spyi bor dbang bskur bas tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rkang mthil yan gyi lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ bum pa rna ltag g.yon du bzhag la/ lus la las kyi tshe dbang bskur// bu khyod 'chi bdag las grol te// bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel nas// srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /oṃ karma ā yudz+nyā na sid+dhi sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ bsam gtan stobs= sogs/ de ltar dbang bskur bas 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang*/ khyad par du'ang phrag dog gi sgo nas gzhan gyi srog bcad pas tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag /las kyi tshe dpag med pa'i ngo bor gyur/ chu'i lhag ma rna ltag g.yon du gnas pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de ltar tshe lha rigs lnga'i sgo nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu'i dbang bskur ba thob nas/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag nas dbang bskur ba ni/ pad+ma'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ pad+ma a+tubha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ rang gi rigs bdag gtso bor gnas pas dbu brgyan par mos la cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

rigs lnga'i cod pan bcings la/ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca traṃ/ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ karma a bhi ṣiñca āḥ dar dpyangs bcings la/ paṭ+ṭa a wa lam bi ni a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ shes rab stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// sogs dang*/ de nas dbang gi mtha' rten du rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun gyi dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ gzugs brnyan nam phyag rgya sbyin zhing*/ gser las legs byas lte ba shin tu zlum// rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang*// dang po'i sa las rnam par rgyal gyur gang*// 'khor lo rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ bdud thams cad las rgyal ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo nam mkha'i mthas gtug par bskor nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /dri med bai ḍūr+ya 'dra'i rin po che// kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed pa// sgrib med mtshan mo ci 'dra nyin de bzhin// nor bu rin chen= /ma ṇi rat+na= tshe dpag tu med pa'i 'od dang ldan zhing lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad rang rang gi gzi brjid kyis zil gyis non pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /gang zhig reg bya'i gzugs dang mdangs ldan pa// bud med dam pa dregs ldan rnams kyi mchog /lha mo bzhin du yon tan kun ldan pa// btsun mo rin chen= s+tṛ rat+na= sems can thams cad ting nge 'dzin zhi ba'i tshul gyis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdag dang gzhan gyi don bde bas bsgrub pa la/ yid bzhin du 'byor ba'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /gang yang 'di na rgyal la mu tig dang*/ gser sogs shin tu mang po dbul ba yis// nor ldan mtshungs par nor mang ldan pa yi/ khyim bdag rin chen// gṛ ha pa ti rat+na= lha'i mig rnam par dag pa thob ste/ 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang ldan zhing rang dang gzhan gyi don dgongs pa ma lus pa mthar phyin nas shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig

/yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni// rab gnas gangs can rtse 'dra'i glang po mchog /rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i// glang po rin chen= /hasti rat+na= stobs bcu dang ldan zhing bdud bzhi'i stobs tshar gcod nas sems can thams cad theg pa chen po la 'jug nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i// sa rnams bskor nas slar yang ldog gyur gang*// rma bya'i mgrin 'dra spu ni yid 'ong ba'i// rta mchog rin chen dam= /tu raṅga a shwa rat+na= /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhis 'gro ba rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su thogs pa med par bskyal nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /'gro dang kun tu gnas dang rnam rtog par// ma lus dpung la mkhas par byed pa yis// dpal ldan bdun par 'byung 'gyur mi yi ni// blon po rin chen= /pu ru ṣa rat+na= thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i dgongs pa mthar phyin nas/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri bo mthon po nyi shu 'joms shing ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig / rdzas brgyad dbang ni/ oṃ h+ya gṛ wā hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ swa bha wā sogs bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las so so'i ming yig dang po las skyes pa'i bkra shis pa'i rdzas rnams nus mthu phul du byung bar gyur/ re re ltar so sor lag tu gtad cing*/ yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du// bgegs rnams ma lus med par byed pa ste// mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa// bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes yungs kar phyag tu phul nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa bzhin du/ deng 'dir rdo rje'i slob ma rnams la yungs kar gyi rdzas la brten nas bkra shis par gyur cig /

gong bzhin thog mtha' 'dra bar/ dūrba tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrubs nas// nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshe ni 'phel bar shog ཾ/rtswa 'tshong bkra shis kyi dur ba= ཾ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa rnams// byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang don ni 'grub gyur cig /lha tshangs pas shing tog bil ba= /gi'u waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman// sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur na// nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig /glang po che nor skyong gis gi'u waṃ= /li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te// chos rnams ma dor dbang du 'dus nas kyang*// chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang khyod srid brtan gyur cig /bram ze kar rgyal gyis li khri= /zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste// snying po rnam dag ye shes mchog rtogs nas// yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi bar shog /zhing gi bu mo legs skyes mas zho= /me long ye shes chen po'i rgya mtsho las// ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te// rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i// bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long= /dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrog pa'i tshul// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur cig /chos rnams ma lus yongs su ston byed pa'i// bkra shis des kyang tshig dbang thob par shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phyag tu phul= / sogs kyis mchog tu shis par bya'o// brtan byed ni/

da dbang bskur ba de nyid brtan par bya ba'i phyir byin gyis brlab pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus lhar gsal ba'i snying gar pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rigs lnga'i tshe dpag med/ spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkhar ye shes tshe dpag med/ de'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas tshe dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*/ lha mi'i rig 'dzin rnams kyi mthu dang 'jig rten gsum gyi brtan g.yo'i bcud thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus/ ye shes tshe dpag med la thim/ de nyid bdud rtsir zhu ba'i tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rigs lngar thim zhing*/ rigs lnga zhu ba'i bdud rtsis lus thams cad la khyab cing gang bas lus kyi zungs dang sems kyi rten du gyur pa las mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku gsung thugs dang khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par sgoms shig / ces gzungs gnyis po gang rung lan gsum bzla/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ nga ni ye shes tshe dpag med// kun tu brnyas par spang bar gyis// 'chi bdag chen po ngas bcom pas// bu khyod tshe yi dngos grub brnyes// zhes brjod/ de ltar dbang bskur zab mo thob pas phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig srung sdom la tshul bzhin bslab snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ lus longs spyod kyi drug cha 'bul snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams sogs/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das pad+ma rigs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba 'chi med tshe 'od snang ba dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo nas smin byed zab mo legs par grub pas de la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrubs shig /bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod par bya'o// rjes chog ni/

mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs sngags mchod dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan cho ga'i sogs/ bzod gsol dang*/ yig brgyas lhag chad bshags/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang sogs/ spyan drangs pa'i bdag mdun sogs brjod/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa brtan bzhugs dang*/ sprul pa'i dam tshig sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod/ dge ba 'di yis sogs dang*/ bkra shis brjod cing dga' ston bya/ bsod nams 'di yi mthu yis ni// 'khor ba'i 'gro drug ma lus pa// tshe dpag med pa'i bka' thob nas// gnad gcod la sogs sdug bsngal rnams// zhi nas bde dang ldan gyur cig / zhes sogs kyi dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab par bya'o// yang rang gzhan gyi don du 'chi bslu byed par 'dod na/ dang po mchod pa bsham bkod kyi skabs nas dgos pa'i de'ang dkyil 'khor gyi lhor tshe mdo/ byang du 'chi med rnga sgra'i mdo dang*/ tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan bcas dar dmar po'i na bza' gsol la khri'u khar bzhugs/ nub tu snod 'brus bkang ba'i dbus dar dmar po la tshe bsnyen gsum gang rung bris pa'i mthar 'chang ba po la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes gser sogs mtshal gyis bris pa bzhag la mdun bskyed bsnyen dmigs dus byin brlab bya/ dkyil 'khor bum bskyed thon pa dang*/ slob dpon nam las rdor gyis las sngags brjod bzhin/ las bum chus bsrung bya bkrus pa'i chu phyed kham phor gsar pa zhig tu blugs la bzhag /phyed de sa nag dang*/ mchod rten rnying pa'am sāts+tsha zhig pa'i sa/ rdza thal dang ro bsregs shul sa/ tshig nag rnams bsres pa las gshin rje'i gzugs nag po ma he'i mgo can/ lag gnyis bsnol thabs kyis g.yas thod dbyug dkar po dang g.yon zhags pa nag po thogs pa/ rkang pa dor stabs kyis kha cung zad sbub pa/ mgo dkyil 'khor lho la bstan cing*/ lcags snod bor chog cig gi nang du ras nag pos gdong bkab la bzhag

/de'i 'og tu re phyar nag po'i khar snod bor chog pa'am/ gang bder/ me tog nag po'am/ 'bru nag /sran nag /bra nag /sha rjen/ mar/ bu ram/ tshwa/ sgog pa/ btsong*/ la phug /g.yer ma sogs dang*/ gzhan yang zas sna tshogs/ bsrung bya dang sgrub pa po rnams kyi lnga bcang dang*/ gos dar ras ther phrug /gcan lpags sogs kyi ras mo/ gser dngul/ zangs lcags/ g.yu/ byu ru sogs/ rin po che'i rigs brdar ba'i phye ma sa dang bsres la gru bzhi byas pa tshon gyis mdog bsgyur ba rdzongs 'debs rgyu rnams bkod cing*/ de rnams 'jal ba'i bre la/ oṃ asma sarba tsi swā hā/ rgya ma la/ oṃ shin tu mthong ba'i rgyal po swā hā/ zho cha la/ oṃ ma ti pra mo dha na thibs swā hā/ ces lha 'dre mig bsgyur ba'i sngags so sor nyer gcig re btab la bzhag /bsrung bya'i gos rnying dum bu la tshon skud sna lnga 'dom re yod pas rgya gram du bcings la dkyil 'khor drung ngam byang ngos su rtswa ku sha'i gdan la bsham/ mdun nya'i sha dang rus pa dang*/ me snod cig kyang bzhag /stegs kyi khar snod gtsang mar zan dkar mngar sum sbrus kyi 'brang rgyas phyed dkar phyed nag la mdog mtshungs kyi sdong bu lnga re so sor btsugs la dkar ngos dkyil 'khor dang*/ nag ngos gshin rje la bstan nas bsham/ kham phor khrus chu'ang de drung bzhag /tshon skud bcad pa'i gri gsar pa yod na dang*/ med na mer bsregs shing chus bran pas 'thus/ yang kham phor gsar pa 'o chab kyis bkang pa zhig kyang bzhag /dkyil 'khor shar du slob dpon dang*/ tshogs pa rnams byang dang*/ lhor bzhugs pa'i phan tshun mchod dpon rnams kyang 'khod/ dang po dkyil 'khor cho ga gzhung bzhin bton nas dbang bskur na bdag 'jug zin pa dang*/ de min cha gsum gtor ma sogs btang grub nas bsrung bya mdun du 'khod/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer sngags phreng 'phros/ mdun bskyed lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/

phyag gi bum pa'i nang du bsgrub bya dmigs la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsol bar mos la tshe bsnyen bzla'o// de nas gshin rje'i gdong kheb bsal/ chu gtsang bran la/ oṃ h+ya gṝ wa sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las las kyi gshin rje yi dwags kyi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ gzugs de gshin rje dngos su dmigs pa dang*/ bdud bzhi dang*/ lo gshed bcu gnyis gshed chen bdun brgya nyi shu/ 'chi bdag bye ba dgu 'bum/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu sogs 'byung po yi dwags tshogs kyis bskor bar bskyed la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi = chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= de bzhin gshegs pa dang pad+ma dang rdo rje'i rigs thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis 'dir mchis par gyur cig /ṭā k+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ lan gsum brjod la gzugs dang dbyer med bsam/ glud rdzas byin brlabs ni/ thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin du/ gzugs mdzes= /sku 'byams klas= /'jigs pa thams cad dang yongs su bral ba= /

mchod sbyin phyag rgya dang bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ lan bdun brjod/ lho phyogs pa rnams kyis tshe gzungs tshar re thon pa dang*/ rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe'i rkyen dang srog gi glud dang 'bru sna zas sna la sogs pa 'dong bre khal gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum sa ya bye ba dung phyur grangs med pa rnams 'bul lo// ces bre la 'jal zhing gshin rje'i mdun du btab/ yang*/ rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe'i rkyen dang srog gi glud du changs bu dang*/ sha rjen/ bu ram/ tshwa/ dar ras gos phrug la sogs pa rgya ma khal gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum sa ya bye ba dung phyur grangs med pa 'bul lo// rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po sogs/ gser dngul g.yu byu ru rin po che'i rigs thogs tshad zho srang bre chen gcig= ces thur srang gi gzhal nas btab bo// deng phyin chad rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la gnod cing 'tshe bar ma byed cig /khram la btab pa phyis/ rtsis la bab na spos/ zhags pas btab na khrol/ bzung ba thongs/ mnan pa khyog /dus kyi chad pa las grol bar mdzod cig / ces gzungs dang spel mar brgya'am bsrung bya'i lo grangs bton la tshar rjes mar rol mo'i zhabs lag len pa rnams nas/ da ni 'jal grangs mang bas bre yang chag thal lo// brjod/ yang*/ da ni bkyag che bas rgya srang 'thor song ngo*// yang*/ da ni gzhal gzhal gyis thur srang yang chag grum thal lo// brjod cing so sor bcag gtib byas la btab bo// dang po tshe gzungs 'don dus nas byang phyogs pa rnams kyi'ang rnga sgra'i gzungs tshar re 'don la/ nya'i sha rus kyi dud pas gos dang tshon skud bdug cing*/ 'gugs pa'i rgyas/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun= de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs thams cad dang*/

gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po'i tshe dang srog la nye bar 'tshe ba'i nad gdon bar chad/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad tshon skud sna lnga 'di la khug cig /ṭā k+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ lan gsum brjod/ ces gzungs dang bden brjod spel ma brgya'am lo grangs brjod nas phan tshun gnyis kyi 'don grangs 'theb pa dang*/ 'brang rgyas phyed gshags pa'i nag po'i sgron me spar ba dang*/ khrus chu'i kham phor bcas gshin rje'i mdun du bkod nas gral mdor khyer la kha lhor bstan la rol mo dang bcas/ sgrub po rnams lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na// dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol na// thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer du// yi dwags kun gyi sde dpon po// ma mo kun gyi tshogs rje po// gson gshin kun gyi zam kha ba// gson po skos la 'debs pa po// shi ba rnams kyi gshed bu che// dge ba can gyi stangs 'dzin pa// sdig pa can gyi chad pa mkhan// legs nyes chos bzhin spyod pa po// chos rgyal gshin rje zhes bya ba// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu rlabs can// 'khor bcas 'dir ni bdag la nyon// khyod kyi 'khor gyi yi dwags la// bza' ba bzang po 'di 'bul gyi// 'di zo 'khor gyi yi dwags rnams// ma 'tshe bar ni gnas su dengs// zhes dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// kyi bar dang*/ rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*// dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod// 'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste// dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de// mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med// 'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem// rang gi lus la dpe longs la// gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig

/oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gis// lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i// nad de myur du phyungs nas ni// gdon de rang gi gnas su dengs// de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyi// mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yi// dam tshig la ni gnas nas su// bdag gi bsam pa bskang bar mdzod// rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing*// 'dir ni bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// nad de rab tu sol mdzod la// gdon rnams rang gi gnas su song*// oṃ sarba bigh+nān gats+tshaḥ zhes lho phyogs grong zad pa'i mtshams su bskyal bcug /de nas gos kyi tshon skud bkrol nas bsgrub bya rkang lag bsnol ba'i yan lag lnga bcings shing*/ kham phor 'o chus bkang ba'ang mdun du bzhag la/ slob dpon gyis gri 'dzin cing*/ gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang*// tshangs pa dang ni 'jig rten skyong*// gnod sbyin sde dpon dbang phyug gtso// de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyis// che ge zhes bya'i slob ma 'di'i// byad ltems las rnams chad gyur cig /oṃ sarba bhan+dha ka ka ra tats+tshi da na ya swā hā/ tshon skud dum bu mang du gtub cing*/ las bum gyi chu thigs re dang bcas kham phor du dor bzhin pas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo// de bzhin du chos dge 'dun la sbyar zhing gong ltar bya/ sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug nges par bcom mo// de bzhin du/ chos= /dge 'dun= /rang sangs rgyas kyi= /dgra bcom pa'i= /phyir mi 'ong ba'i= /rgyun du zhugs pa'i= /bden par smra ba'i= /tshangs pa'i be con gyis dug= /dbang po'i rdo rje'i= /khyab 'jug gi 'khor los= /me lha'i dbal gyis= /chu lha'i zhags pas= /lha ma yin gyi rgyus= klu'i rigs sngags kyis=

/drag po'i mdung rtses= /skem byed kyi mdung thung gis dug nges par bcom mo// dug sa'i nang du song zhig /chu yi nang = /me'i= /rlung gi= sogs brjod tshe gong bzhin byas la mthar khrus chu gos dang lhan cig byang phyogs grong zad sar bskyal/ snga rjes gnyis kar yar 'ong dus phyi mig mi blta bar gnad yin gsungs/ de nas 'brang rgyas dkar po la sgron me spar zhing bran/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ mtshan sngags la/ na maḥsarba btags pa gsum gyis lha la 'bul nas bsgrub byar gtad de/ dbyangs dang bcas/ bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyi zas// snying po bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni// de ring bu yis za bar gyis// 'di zos sangs rgyas tshe dpag med// zhal zas bsten nas nad kun la// grol 'gyur the tshom bya mi dgos// mtshan sngags brjod cing me tog 'thor la longs spyod du 'jug /de nas dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing khrus la sogs pa bya/ dbang mi bskur na'ang bsgrub bya bkru byab bsrung pa dang*/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas rnams byin la/ rjes kyi tshe gzhung las mjug tu sāts+tsha cung zad gdab/ sa tshon la sogs chur dor te/ tshe dpag med pa'i gzungs kyang 'don zhes gsungs pas rang gzhan gnyis kas sāts+tsha gdab pa dang*/ tshe gzungs bzla zhing tshe thar btang ba sogs nges par bya'o// zhes bla ma rin chen mgon gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor gar dbang rdo rje 'chang chen po dkon mchog yan lag gi zhal snga nas/ dkyil chog bstsal ba gzhir bzhag nas smin dbang gi skabs dang*/ 'chi bslu'i 'don bya lag len rnams sngon rabs mkhas dang grub pa'i legs bshad dag gi nye bar brgyan te/ si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis bkod ba'i dge bas 'gro rnams 'chi med rtag pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /sarba maṅga lam/// /
